preToolUse.bash: set -f; IFS=:; for d in $PATH; do case $d in /*) if [ -f "$d/alalanet-agent" ] && [ -x "$d/alalanet-agent" ]; then exec "$d/alalanet-agent" hook copilot; fi;; esac; done; printf '%s\n' '{"type":"progress","message":"alalanet guard: no executable alalanet-agent in an absolute PATH folder, so this command was NOT checked. Install it from https://alalanet.com/dl and put it on PATH."}'
preToolUse.powershell: $w = $env:OS -eq 'Windows_NT'; $n = if ($w) { 'alalanet-agent.exe' } else { 'alalanet-agent' }; $abs = if ($w) { '^([A-Za-z]:[\\/]|[\\/]{2})' } else { '^/' }; foreach ($d in ($env:PATH -split [IO.Path]::PathSeparator)) { if ($d -match $abs) { $p = Join-Path $d $n; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p -PathType Leaf) { try { & $p hook copilot; exit $LASTEXITCODE } catch { } } } }; [ordered]@{type='progress';message='alalanet guard: no executable alalanet-agent in an absolute PATH folder, so this command was NOT checked. Install it from https://alalanet.com/dl and put it on PATH.'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; exit 0
